title: Satisfaction Trial Days, Miles and Remedy — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
Each Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty line carries a satisfaction trial: a customer not satisfied with the ride of a new set may give it back within the line's trial days, counted from the installation date, provided the set has not run more than the line's trial miles since installation.

| Line | Trial days | Trial miles | What the trial offers | Installation charges returned with the tires | Trial returns per vehicle |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Value Touring 40K Treadwear Warranty | 30 | 1,500 | exchange only — store credit toward another Crestline tire line | No | 1 |
| Crestline All-Season 50K Treadwear Warranty | 30 | 1,500 | refund or exchange, at the customer's choice | No | 1 |
| Crestline Grand Touring 60K Treadwear Warranty | 45 | 3,000 | refund or exchange, at the customer's choice | No | 1 |
| Crestline Highway Terrain LT 65K Treadwear Warranty | 45 | 3,000 | refund or exchange, at the customer's choice | No | 1 |
| Crestline Premium Touring 75K Treadwear Warranty | 60 | 5,000 | refund or exchange, at the customer's choice | Yes | 1 |
| Crestline Ultra Touring 85K Treadwear Warranty | 60 | 5,000 | refund or exchange, at the customer's choice | Yes | 1 |

Trial miles in figures without separators: 1500, 1500, 3000, 3000, 5000, 5000, in line order. The trial-return allowance of 1 counts every tire set ever bought for the same vehicle.

**Trial miles, both sides (hypothetical sets):** on a line with 3,000 trial miles, a set showing 3,000 miles since installation is within the trial miles and one showing 3,001 is not.
